title: Oracle restoration after three steps
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input word, $f$ a tape content, and $p$ a nonzero integer; let $side$ and $verdict$ be Boolean values. For every valid input-head position and output word, running the oracle-dispatch machine for three steps from the ready configuration containing the one-letter verdict word in read state yields the back configuration at position $p$, with bookmark $1$ if $side$ is true and $-1$ otherwise, and with back state carrying the verdict and side; the input-head position and output are preserved.
